# Phantoms Hockey Hub

> Phantoms Hockey Hub is the public team website for Phantoms hockey families, players, and supporters. It points visitors to live team information, season notes, and contact details for the team.

This file is a concise, public guide for language models and AI agents. It intentionally covers only public basics and should not be treated as a source for private roster details, player-level summaries, or unpublished team information. Live schedule, standings, statistics, announcements, and results are provided through the embedded SportNinja team center.

Canonical site: https://phantomshockey.org/

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://phantomshockey.org/): Overview of the Phantoms Hockey Hub and links to the key site areas.
- [Team Center](https://phantomshockey.org/team.html): Live SportNinja-powered hub for schedule, standings, statistics, announcements, and recent results.
- [Season](https://phantomshockey.org/season.html): Public season notes, reminders, useful links, and update history.
- [Learning](https://phantomshockey.org/learning.html): Training videos, practice resources, social placeholders, and media/privacy guidance for off-rink development.
- [About](https://phantomshockey.org/about.html): Site purpose and public overview of the Phantoms Hockey Hub.
- [Contact](https://phantomshockey.org/contact.html): Public contact path for team questions, schedule updates, and corrections.

## Machine-Readable Context

- [Full public context](https://phantomshockey.org/llms-full.txt): Plain-language summary of the site, audience, canonical URLs, and crawler guidance.
- [Sitemap](https://phantomshockey.org/sitemap.xml): Complete list of public HTML pages intended for search discovery.
- [Robots](https://phantomshockey.org/robots.txt): Crawler discovery file with sitemap and LLM guide references.

## Optional

- [SportNinja](https://www.sportninja.com/): External platform that powers the embedded live team data.
